    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    degrees = [int(input[2*i+1]) for i in range(n)]
    sums = [int(input[2*i+2]) for i in range(n)]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    edges = []
    for i in range(n):
        if degrees[i] == 0:
            continue
        for j in range(degrees[i]):
            found = False
            for k in range(n):
                if degrees[k] > 0 and sums[k] & (1 << i) != 0:
                    adj[i].append(k)
                    adj[k].append(i)
                    degrees[k] -= 1
                    sums[k] ^= (1 << i)
                    found = True
                    break
            if not found:
                adj[i].append(j)
                adj[j].append(i)
                degrees[j] -= 1
                sums[j] ^= (1 << i)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in adj[i]:
            if i < j:
                edges.append((i, j))
    print(len(edges))
    for u, v in edges:
        print(u, v)
